titulo: Her tea drunk hot, mine left steaming
caption:
Her tea drunk hot, mine left steaming

My roommate drinks her tea the moment it's ready. Mine she leaves steaming until I'm home.

A hot drink is at its warmest in the first minutes, so the quick sip is the hottest one.

For whoever drinks the tea hot and still keeps one warm.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, and two orange mugs with steam sit on the floor in the middle. A bubble says tea's ready. Then ahh, and the figure's eyes turn happy with a pulse as the steam over its own mug stops. The other mug keeps steaming. A brick red figure walks in from the right and a bubble says sorry, late! The black one says yours is hot and both pulse as the last steam stops. The text stays: me drinking my tea before you get here. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
